body:
I know there is hardly anything to go by here. But it would still be nice if you could provide some more information:

- which language was the script you were trying to open written in?
- was the script you were trying to open builtin?
- is your editor configured to generally use an external editor (C# is always opened in an external editor regardless of editor settings)?
- what command is configured to start VSCode?
- did you try to recover a crash report for Godot or Windows?

> I know there is hardly anything to go by here. But it would still be nice if you could provide some more information: > > * which language was the script you were trying to open written in? C#. > * was the script you were trying to open builtin? I don't understand the question, sorry. > * is your editor configured to generally use an external editor (C# is always opened in an external editor regardless of editor settings)? It's configured to use "Visual Studio Code and VSCodium". > * what command is configured to start VSCode? > * did you try to recover a crash report for Godot or Windows? Unfortunately I had logs disabled during the crashes. If it occurs again I will post any logs I find. With regards to crash reports, since I had to hard-restart my PC I wasn't able to get anything like that.

Side note: I did spend a few hours trying to find the cause of this issue in the Godot repository, without any success. However, I did note that scripts are opened externally whenever the inspector displays the script resource, so anything that causes the inspector to repeatedly display a resource could be the cause of the issue.

It happened once again, and this time it happened while exporting my game for Windows. However, I wasn't doing anything, it suddenly happened during the export process.
